relations.subject: N. H. Samtani
relations.evidence: In July 1957, Shri (now Dr.) N. H. Samtani, M.A., joined as a Research Fellow the Department of Buddhist Studies... and was awarded the degree of Doctor of Philosophy by Delhi University in 1961.

relations.subject: N. H. Samtani
relations.evidence: He had finished the first reading of the Text and the Commentary with me before I retired from Delhi University in July 1960. My successor, there, Dr. V. V. Gokhale became his guide.

relations.subject: N. H. Samtani
relations.evidence: My successor, there, Dr. V. V. Gokhale became his guide. I was glad to learn that under his guidance, Shri Samtani finished his work in due course, and was awarded the degree of Doctor of Philosophy
